guards.what: G1: C#'s AfterSideTurnStart is post-draw (turn_structure step 23); the sim's slot must match
guards.issue: Closed (round 11 re-settle, no engine edit made by this pass -- the sim already carries `after_side_turn_start`, which post-dates this guard's own prose). `booming_conch.py:31` implements `after_side_turn_start`, not `on_player_turn_start` as this guard's `what` still described; `player.py:187-235` runs `_setup_player_turn()` (energy reset, draw, `on_player_turn_started`) and only fires `after_side_turn_start` on line 235 AFTER that call returns, matching CombatManager.cs step 22 (draw) before step 23 (AfterSideTurnStart). EXECUTED (`.superpowers/sdd/unlabelled/probes/relic-8-booming-conch.py`): a traced fresh Elite-room combat prints call order `[('draw', 7, True), ('after_side_turn_start',)]`, draw strictly first. WAS: 'G1 (DORMANT): C#'s AfterSideTurnStart is post-draw (turn_structure step 23); the sim uses on_player_turn_start, which the turn-order probe places PRE-draw, four steps earlier' -- The relic's own two halves end up on opposite sides of the draw from the source's arrangement: C# adds the cards (ModifyHandDraw, step 20), draws, and only then grants the energy (step 23); the sim grants the energy at step ~19 and then draws. Anything that reads the player's energy during the turn-1 draw sees 3 in C# and 4 in the sim. REACHABILITY (DORMANT): the readers would be an on-draw card effect or a modify_hand_draw listener that branches on current energy, and no ported content does either -- the ported modify_hand_draw listeners (bag_of_preparation, big_mushroom, this relic) all branch on turn number and room type only. Porting an energy-reading draw effect makes it live. Same family as relic/bag_of_marbles' G1, which is why the correct sim slot for AfterSideTurnStart is on_player_turn_startED.

guards.what: G2 (DORMANT): C# grants the energy through PlayerCmd.GainEnergy, which runs Hook.ModifyEnergyGain and Hook.AfterModifyingEnergyGain; the sim assigns player.energy directly (booming_conch.py:34)
guards.issue: MECHANISM: PlayerCmd.GainEnergy (PlayerCmd.cs) computes `finalAmount = Hook.ModifyEnergyGain(...)`, awaits Hook.AfterModifyingEnergyGain over the modifiers, and grants only `if (finalAmount > 0)`. The sim HAS that chain -- EnergyCmd.gain (cmds.py) calls hooks.modify_energy_gain(player, amount) before adding, and relic/art_of_war uses it -- but booming_conch.py:34 does `player.energy += self.ENERGY` and skips it. REACHABILITY (DORMANT, and the reason is a timing accident worth recording): the sim's one ported modify_energy_gain listener is NoEnergyGainPower (powers.py:554-558), which returns 0 for its owner, and it is applied to the PLAYER by the ported card expect_a_fight. Under it, C# would grant 0 and the sim grants 1. But NoEnergyGainPower expires at the owner's turn end (powers.py:559-561) and Booming Conch fires only on turn <= 1 -- before any card can be played -- so the two can never overlap today. Porting any monster or relic that applies NoEnergyGain before the player's first turn, or any modify_energy_gain listener without the turn-end expiry, makes it live.
